_comment: Module 5.2 background diagnosis: hand labels for the (profile skill -> role skill) pairs behind the background check's related credits (assistant's judgement, 2026-10-17). 'real overlap' = a person with the profile skill genuinely has the role skill (the role skill is that same competence or is directly implied by it); every pair not listed here is a 'false match' (semantic credit for an unrelated or merely neighbouring skill, e.g. a different tool of the same family). Borderline calls are noted.

Figma: create prototype of user experience solutions

notes.Inventory Management -> Excel: false match (decided 2026-10-17 by the project team: the chef profile does not list Excel); earlier counted as real overlap
notes.Inventory Management -> identify softwar: real overlap in meaning (warehouse / stock management), although ESCO lists the phrase under data warehouse designer
notes.Customer Service -> identify customer re: false match: ICT requirements and application-feedback phrases, not customer service
notes.Customer Service -> Salesforce: false match: a CRM tool the profile does not list
notes.Docker -> Kubernetes / Ansible / DevOps: false match under this rule: neighbouring tools the profile does not list
